description: Adaptive performance & quality: in-app frame-pacing meter with a hysteresis-driven, visual-only degradation ladder (pixel ratio, sparkle/confetti budgets, contact shadows + gleam), upgrades at rest, hidden ?debug readout, and a hard CI perf gate on CPU-throttled Chromium (p95 budget after adaptation, adaptation engaged). 60 fps target / 30 fps floor; no physics, audio, UI-setting, save, or asset changes; no new dependencies.
